candidates.defline: Brilliance holds your chart’s strongest seat: your prime is built to break forms and sign the result.
candidates.reading: This position rules Career and Mind from the chart’s deepest seat. Your prime runs on creative force strong enough to bend the trade you enter: you see the better way immediately and cannot politely unsee it. Employers experience you as weather. The resolution is authorship, work where your name absorbs your output, founding, art, research, reform. Aim the force at problems, not personnel. Genius forgiven is genius that picked its battles.
